## 主张 Claim

给定转移、观察、目标与许可时，n 步 viable 等价于存在一个依观察分支且 works 的 n 步方案。 / For supplied transitions, observations, target and admissibility, n-step viable is equivalent to an observation-branching n-step plan satisfying works.

## 沿革 History

- 2026-10-08：迁移既有成果身份与范围；不新增定理，不移动原始资料。 / 2026-10-08: migrated existing result identity and scope; no new theorem or relocated source.
- 2026-10-15，整合 I3c（Ren：“a lot proofs are probably not integrated”）：在脊柱上陈述（新核心模块 Becoming.Keeping）。一步可用于一个配置类，指它在每个配置处都被容许且可走（Usable）；该步所登记者使类收窄（Seen，登记可列举时即 InquirySufficiency.After）。一类保持 n 步，指守卫遍及该类，且有某个可用之步无论登记什么都留下保持少一步的类（KeptFor）。依所登记者给出后续之步的方案保持该类其长度之久，不加前提（Plan.Keeps.keptFor）；登记可列举时每个被保持之类都有这样的方案，不加前提（keptFor_iff_plan）；对任意登记，这恰是对登记的选择（plans_iff_choice，选择为具名假设 ChoiceOver）。更细的登记保持更粗的登记所保持者（KeptFor.finer）；Viability 的证书在其中有一步处处可用时使其中每类对每个时程都被保持（Certificate.keptFor、Kernel.keptFor）；登记一个隐藏的位可决定保持与否（Matching.registration_matters）。外围实例：ContinuationAdequacy 的 viable 即以到达的配置为登记的 KeptFor（ContinuationCorrespondence.viable_iff_keptFor），方案两向互译（works_iff_keeps、keeps_iff_works），故 viable_iff_plan 由核心律与 Classical.choice 给出（viable_iff_plan_by_core），观察可列举时不用公理（viable_iff_plan_listed）。外围证明及其回执保持原范围。Becoming.Keeping 由核心运行审计（回执 20261015T150956.178111Z，公理报告为空）；外围实例模块 ContinuationCorrespondence 由其检查器以 Lean 4.30.0-rc2 与 Mathlib 实查（回执 20261015T151901.978501Z）：单一方案的对应与可列举的情形公理报告为空，Classical.choice 只在 classicalChoice 与 viable_iff_plan_by_core 中，共同方案的几条用 propext 与 Quot.sound。 / 15 October 2026, integration I3c (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): stated on the spine (new core module Becoming.Keeping). A move is usable from a class of configurations where it is allowed and enabled at each of them (Usable), and what its step registers narrows the class (Seen, which is InquirySufficiency.After where registrations are listed). A class is kept for n steps where the guard holds throughout and some usable move leaves, whatever is registered, a class kept one step fewer (KeptFor). A plan whose later moves follow what was registered keeps the class for its length, with no premise (Plan.Keeps.keptFor); where registrations are listed every kept class has such a plan, with no premise (keptFor_iff_plan); for arbitrary registrations that is exactly choice over the registrations (plans_iff_choice, choice the named hypothesis ChoiceOver). A finer registration keeps what a coarser one keeps (KeptFor.finer); a certificate of Viability with a move usable throughout keeps every class within it for every horizon (Certificate.keptFor, Kernel.keptFor); registering a hidden bit can decide keeping (Matching.registration_matters). Periphery instance: ContinuationAdequacy’s viable is KeptFor with the configuration reached registered (ContinuationCorrespondence.viable_iff_keptFor), plans translate both ways (works_iff_keeps, keeps_iff_works), so viable_iff_plan follows from the core law with Classical.choice (viable_iff_plan_by_core), and with no axiom for listed observations (viable_iff_plan_listed). The periphery proofs and their receipts keep their scope. Becoming.Keeping is audited by the core run (receipt 20261015T150956.178111Z, empty axiom reports); the periphery instance module ContinuationCorrespondence is checked by its own checker with Lean 4.30.0-rc2 and Mathlib (receipt 20261015T151901.978501Z): the single-plan correspondence and the listed case have empty axiom reports, Classical.choice occurs only in classicalChoice and viable_iff_plan_by_core, and the joint-plan declarations use propext and Quot.sound.
